name: The Black Ledger Company
symbol: a black book bound with a silver chain
text: A trading company that sells swords, safe passage and silence along the frontier roads. It keeps its contracts to the letter and collects on them the same way, and its agents turn up wherever a town is growing faster than its watch.

name: The Compass Lodge
motto: North is wherever the gold is.
symbol: a compass rose with a sword for its needle
text: An adventurers' guild with a hall in every town that pays bounties. Members share maps, split the cost of healing, and post contracts of their own on the places the council has not got round to.

name: The Crown League
symbol: a ring of towers around a crown
text: A league of mayors, lords and free cities who pledge to answer one another's beacons. Joining costs a town some of its freedom and a tithe of its taxes, and pays back in soldiers when the warbands march.

name: The Wardens of the Dawn Gate
motto: We hold the gate until morning.
symbol: a gate with the sun rising through it
text: A knightly order sworn to stand between frontier towns and the dark. Its knights drill the militia, hunt cults and undead, and answer to their own chapter-house before any mayor.

name: The Guild of the Gilded Scale
motto: Fair weight, fair price, fair profit.
symbol: a gilded scale over a stack of coins
text: The merchants' and craftsmen's guild. It sets prices, settles disputes between members, sends its own caravans when the roads allow, and never stops reminding the council who pays most of the taxes.

name: The Hollow Choir
symbol: a mouth sewn shut with black thread
text: A death cult that finds the bereaved and the desperate and promises them their dead back. It meets in cellars and old crypts, robs graves for its rites, and if it is left alone long enough the dead around the town begin to walk.

name: The Lanternbearers
motto: A light where it is needed, and no one the wiser.
symbol: a lantern pin worn inside a collar
text: A secret network of spies, bards and wanderers who work against tyrants and cults. Members rarely know more than two others, pass word by coded songs, and vanish when they are noticed.

name: The Quiet Hand
motto: What is lost was only borrowed.
symbol: an open palm with a coin hidden under the thumb
text: The thieves' guild. It runs burglaries, protection, smuggling and the dice tables in the back rooms, and sells what it hears to whoever pays. It keeps its own peace among the town's thieves, which the watch sometimes finds more useful than it admits.

name: The Silent Knife
text: An assassins' guild that takes contracts through go-betweens and never twice from the same tavern. Towns hear of it only after a council seat falls empty.

name: The Thornward Circle
motto: Take what the land gives, and no more.
symbol: a ring of thorns around a sapling
text: A circle of druids, rangers and hedge-witches who keep the balance between settlement and wild. They bless good harvests and heal blighted fields, and they protest, and sometimes do worse, when the axes go too deep into the forest.

name: The Order of the Unshut Book
motto: Nothing true stays hidden from us for long.
symbol: an open book with a key for a bookmark
text: A society of wizards, reliquarians and scholars who collect relics, maps and secrets. It sponsors scryings, pays well for magic items brought back from the wilds, and quarrels with anyone who would rather a secret stayed buried.

name: The Wolfsbane Company
motto: Paid in full or not at all.
symbol: a wolf's head on a field of purple flowers
text: A free company of sellswords that hires out to any town that can pay. It fights hard while the gold lasts and leaves the morning after it stops.

name: The Ember Court
symbol: a coiled red wyrm around a heap of crowns
text: Ysmeralt, the last daughter of Vermithrax, keeps court in the smoking peaks among kobold priests, bought knights and her father's old bargains. She sells her protection to towns that can fill her hoard, and her fire to anyone who can pay more.

name: The Mire Grandmothers
motto: Every gift has a hook in it.
symbol: three knots in a green cord
text: Three hags who were oracles of the drowned Coil before the sea rose, and who never stopped taking payment for what they see. Granny Wormwood and her sisters bargain with villages, warlords and town councils alike, and their hexes go to whoever pays the strangest price.

name: The Vermilion Conclave
symbol: a scarlet hand holding a burning eye
text: Court wizards of old Caldor who survived the Long Night by selling spells to whoever held the nearest throne. From the Vermilion Spire they rent war-mages to towns and warlords alike, and ask in return for an enclave behind the town's walls and first claim on every relic dug out of the wilds.
